headline: New state general budget eliminates limits on public spending
summary: The executive has filed a bill in the Chamber of Deputies to modify the 2026 General State Budget for a second time. It temporarily suspends the fiscal rule, removing legal limits on public spending and the deficit.
why: A fiscal rule caps government spending and deficits, so suspending it signals looser fiscal policy, which matters to sovereign bond investors and rating agencies.
original_headline: Nuevo presupuesto general del estado elimina límites al gasto público
